title: TenantNetworkPlan
description: Represents the relationship between a network and a plan, including contract details and lifecycle information.

networkPlanEffectiveDate.description: Start date of the plan's inclusion in the network

networkPlanTerminationDate.description: End date of the plan's inclusion in the network

networkPlanStatus.description: Status of the relationship (e.g., Active, Terminated)

isPrimaryNetwork.description: If this is the plan's primary network

isContracted.description: Whether this plan is contracted under the network

sourceSystem.description: Origin of the record (e.g., API, File Upload)

changeReason.description: Optional description of why a change was made
